purpose: Teach: 閉会/ゲン/ヘルス/賜り/設問/緊密/同点/勧める

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、警察、捜査本部の閉会、本当に、目処、つけられそうです、皆様、本当に、ご協力、感謝、申し上げます、いつも、本当に、ありがとうございます、絶対。
lines.en: This case — the investigation is finally wrapping up, and I truly want to thank everyone for their cooperation. It means everything.
lines.style: Measured, formal opening. Slight pause before the gratitude, as if gathering the weight of it. Professional but genuinely warm. Steady eye contact throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の方々、ゲン担ぎの、習慣、結構、いらっしゃるんですね、本当に、興味深く、お話、伺っております、社員、皆、感心しております、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. It's remarkable, actually — the officers here have these superstitions and rituals. We find it quite intriguing. The whole team really admires that dedication.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight lean-in on the praise. Warm without overstepping. The tone of someone listening carefully and wanting the other person to know it landed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ヘルスケアの、サポート、本当に、必要、なってきておりますね、本気で、強化、必要、感じております、隊員、皆、健康、第一、絶対、本当に、頼みます、私からも、絶対。
lines.en: Healthcare support for officers is becoming more critical, and we're taking that seriously. We need to strengthen what we're doing. The whole unit — their health comes first. I want to emphasize that.
lines.style: Firmer than before. A beat of conviction on 'critical.' Professional but carrying personal weight. Not a script — this matters to him. Clear, unbending.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様から、本当に、貴重な、お声、賜り、社員、本当に、励みに、しております、防犯活動、本気で、続けてまいります、絶対、本当に、頼みます、いつも、感謝。
lines.en: Yes. We're truly grateful for the guidance you've given us. It's been motivating for everyone. We're committed to keeping our crime prevention efforts strong — you have our word on that.
lines.style: Earnest, steady. Warm reciprocal tone. A promise underneath the politeness. Not rushed — each phrase given its due weight. The voice of someone who means what he's saying.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 防犯訓練の設問、市民の方々に、わかりやすく、本当に、配慮、しております、皆様の、安全、第一に、考えております、いつも、本当に、絶対、本気、心からの、お願いです。
lines.en: The crime prevention training questions — we've made sure they're clear and accessible for the community. Keeping everyone safe is the priority. That's a sincere request from me.
lines.style: Measured authority with genuine care underneath. Slight emphasis on 'clear.' Not talking down — speaking as someone who takes responsibility. Warm but unwavering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察様と、当社、本当に、緊密な、連携、続けてまいります、地域の、安全のため、絶対に、私たち、本気で、頑張ります、社員、皆、絶対に、頼みます、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We'll keep working closely with your department for the safety of this community. That's a commitment we take seriously — everyone here is ready to do their part.
lines.style: Steady resolve. Slower pace on the commitment. Not performative — the sound of someone making a promise to himself as much as to the room. Warm but solid.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域の、犯罪件数、ライバル地域と、同点、競っているような状況、本当に、危機感、持って、警察、対応、強化してまいります、絶対、本気で、本当に、頼みます、市民、皆、絶対。
lines.en: We're tied with the other district in crime numbers right now, and I won't accept that. We're treating this seriously — we'll strengthen our response. The community is counting on us.
lines.style: Sharp attention on the tied numbers. A note of challenge — not hostile, but determined. Sits forward slightly. Professional urgency without panic. Leadership voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に、警察の活動、自信を持って、勧めるよう、社内、広めてまいります、本当に、立派な、活動、ですから、社員、皆、絶対、感謝、しております、本当に、いつも。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the team understands the quality of your work and feels confident recommending it. It's genuinely impressive what you're doing — everyone here appreciates it.
lines.style: Warm closing. Slight slow-down on 'genuinely impressive,' letting it land. Gratitude that's genuine, not pro forma. Gentle but substantial. The sound of a door closing softly.
